_meta.role: AI Systems Performance Engineer - New Graduate

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology specializing in high-performance AI systems and inference optimization. Built custom CUDA C++ kernels with memory coalescing, applied 8-bit quantization to transformer language models with near-lossless accuracy, and profiled VRAM and latency across ML workloads spanning TensorRT acceleration, MPI on SLURM clusters, and transformers built from scratch in PyTorch.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free vision-language transformer, for structured field extraction, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.
Built PyTorch preprocessing and training pipelines on the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for on-device deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Built a custom image-stitching pipeline with concurrency (PSNR 65 → 86) and deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for 3D crack-depth profiling with ±8% error.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights, and preallocated buffers to remove per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2 ms vs 73.3 ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5 ms (CPU) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU at identical accuracy.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Cut GPU memory ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency with pynvml.
Benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with <1% accuracy loss and +0.09 perplexity — near-lossless compression.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer in PyTorch from scratch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, weight tying, and a TikToken tokenizer.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — M.S. Capstone
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing, achieving a 5.2× inference speedup (56.7 → 10.9 ms, 17.6 → 92 FPS) over eager PyTorch on NVIDIA Jetson.
